items.title: Shakib, Hridoy denied LPL title as Gallants end Jaffna's reign
items.summary: Bangladesh's Shakib Al Hasan and Tawhid Hridoy missed out on Lanka Premier League glory as Galle Gallants ended Jaffna Kings' reign with a five-wicket victory in the final on Saturday.

items.title: 'We let ourselves down' - worries increase for Simmons after tour-game collapse
items.summary: Taijul Islam, who had picked up an injury while batting in the tour game and did not bowl at all, is expected to be fit in time for the first Test

items.title: ‘Clear process’ yields 8-for as rookie pacer Thompson tears through Tigers
items.summary: Despite having played only one previous first-class match, Thompson repeatedly found the right length and forced Bangladesh's batters into mistakes.

items.title: Bangladesh suffer innings defeat, but receive positive Taijul injury update
items.summary: Bangladesh suffered a crushing innings-and-38-run defeat against Cricket Australia XI in the lone three-day warm-up game in Darwin today, just days before the start of their two-match Test series against Australia.

items.title: Bangladesh fold for 54 in Test warm-up as Thompson takes 8 for 25
items.summary: The South Australia left-arm quick stunned the visitors ahead of the first Test next week

items.title: Tigers’ third-pacer conundrum
items.summary: Bangladesh pacers started the morning session on the second day of their three-day warm-up against Cricket Australia XI on the front foot, with Hasan Mahmud castling Josh Phillipe with just his second delivery of the day at the DXC Arena in Darwin yesterday.

items.title: Shakib ready to return to Bangladesh for court trial if given security
items.summary: The former Bangladesh captain hasn't returned to the country since May 2024

items.title: Bangladesh Emerging team reach tri-series final
items.summary: Bangladesh emerging team reached the final of the ongoing tri-series in South Africa after defeating University Sport South Africa (USSA) by seven wickets in their third match at Irene Country Club in Centurion on Friday.

items.title: No way back for Shakib: State Minister for Youth and Sports Aminul
items.summary: Bangladesh said on that Friday former star cricketer Shakib Al Hasan had no prospect of returning to play after he joined a media event with ousted former prime minister Sheikh Hasina, a convicted fugitive.

items.title: Neser suffers calf strain at training, but hopeful for South Africa tour
